orientation.title: Aifya essentials
orientation.summary: Learn the workspace, navigation, search, themes, help tools, and safe offline working.
lessons: Use the sidebar to move between hospital modules and collapse it when you need more working space.
Press Ctrl+K to search for patients, actions, and modules from anywhere in Aifya.
Recognise offline and sync indicators, and continue core work while the network is unavailable.
Use the Help assistant, interactive tours, language switch, and light or dark appearance controls.
Review alerts before acting and never share your account or leave an unlocked clinical workstation.

frontDesk.title: Front desk and patient access
frontDesk.summary: Register patients, prevent duplicates, manage appointments, and coordinate referrals.
lessons: Search by MRN, name, phone, national ID, or SHA number before creating a new patient record.
Register demographics, contacts, next of kin, coverage, allergies, and chronic conditions accurately.
Book, confirm, check in, reschedule, and cancel appointments without losing the audit history.
Create incoming or outgoing referrals, attach the clinical reason, and track acceptance and completion.
Confirm identity with at least two identifiers before opening or updating a patient record.

clinicalCare.title: OPD, emergency, and inpatient care
clinicalCare.summary: Run consultations and admissions from triage through clinician sign-off and discharge.
lessons: Move a checked-in patient through triage, vitals, consultation, diagnosis, orders, and disposition.
Document allergies, observations, clinical notes, diagnoses, procedures, and follow-up plans.
Use emergency acuity to prioritise unstable patients and respond immediately to critical alerts.
Admit patients to a ward and bed, maintain nursing observations, and complete transfer or discharge.
Review and sign every AI-assisted clinical note before it becomes part of the patient record.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics and specialist services
diagnostics.summary: Order and complete laboratory, imaging, theatre, dental, and maternal-child workflows.
lessons: Create diagnostic orders with the correct patient, priority, specimen or study, and clinical question.
Track specimens and imaging worklists from collection or scheduling through verified results.
Escalate critical results immediately and document who was notified and when.
Prepare theatre cases, record procedure milestones, recovery, and post-operative instructions.
Maintain dental charts, ANC profiles, deliveries, immunisations, and child growth follow-up.

medicines.title: Medicines and inventory
medicines.summary: Prescribe, validate, dispense, and replenish stock with patient-safety controls.
lessons: Verify patient, medicine, strength, dose, route, frequency, duration, and indication before saving.
Resolve allergy, duplicate therapy, dose, and interaction alerts before a prescription is signed.
Dispense against an authorised prescription and record the batch, quantity, and counselling provided.
Receive, issue, transfer, count, and adjust stock using batch and expiry information.
Act on low-stock, expired, and near-expiry alerts and preserve an auditable reason for adjustments.

revenue.title: Billing, payments, and insurance
revenue.summary: Build accurate bills, collect payments, and manage insurer and SHA claim workflows.
lessons: Add authorised services, medicines, procedures, and consumables to the correct patient account.
Review payer, tariff, discounts, deposits, and outstanding balances before issuing an invoice.
Record cash, card, bank, or M-Pesa payments and produce a receipt with the correct allocation.
Prepare insurance or SHA claims with supporting diagnoses, services, documents, and approvals.
Track submitted, queried, rejected, and paid claims and reconcile remittances to invoices.

finance.title: Finance and accounting
finance.summary: Manage the ledger, budgets, assets, periods, reconciliation, and statutory reporting.
lessons: Understand how billing, receipts, payroll, and purchases post balanced entries to the general ledger.
Maintain the chart of accounts and review journal transactions without changing historical postings.
Set budgets, register fixed assets, run depreciation, and monitor actual performance against plan.
Open and close accounting periods only after bank, cash, receivable, payable, and control accounts reconcile.
Use trial balance, profit and loss, balance sheet, cash flow, aging, and audit reports for review.

workforce.title: HR, leave, and payroll
workforce.summary: Maintain employee records, approve leave, run payroll, and prepare Kenyan statutory returns.
lessons: Create complete employee records with role, department, bank, KRA, NSSF, and SHIF details.
Record and approve leave while checking balances, dates, cover arrangements, and payroll impact.
Review earnings, deductions, benefits, loans, overtime, and unpaid leave before calculating payroll.
Approve and post payroll only after checking exception reports and authorised totals.
Prepare payslips, P9, PAYE, NSSF, SHIF, Housing Levy, and payroll reconciliation reports.

insights.title: Reports, analytics, and performance
insights.summary: Read operational indicators, investigate trends, and export trustworthy management reports.
lessons: Choose the correct reporting period, facility context, department, and status filters.
Use dashboard totals to identify queues, capacity pressure, clinical alerts, and revenue exceptions.
Drill from summary metrics into source records before making operational decisions.
Compare performance over time and document the definition and source of every shared KPI.
Export only the minimum necessary data and handle patient-identifiable reports securely.

communications.title: Patient and team communications
communications.summary: Send timely, appropriate messages while protecting privacy and communication preferences.
lessons: Confirm the recipient, contact method, language, and consent before sending a message.
Use approved templates for appointment reminders, follow-up, results, and operational notices.
Avoid sensitive diagnosis details in SMS or other channels that may be seen by someone else.
Track delivery status, failed messages, replies, and communication history.

integrations.title: FHIR and external integrations
integrations.summary: Monitor connected systems, resolve mapping issues, and protect data exchanged outside Aifya.
lessons: Understand which patient, encounter, order, result, claim, and facility data each connection exchanges.
Review FHIR mapping, endpoint status, authentication, and the last successful synchronisation.
Investigate failed messages without repeatedly creating duplicate records or submissions.
Use approved credentials and never place API tokens in notes, screenshots, email, or source code.
Escalate persistent interface failures with timestamps, identifiers, and non-sensitive error details.

trials.title: Clinical trials and research
trials.summary: Screen, enrol, schedule, document, and report research activity in line with GCP.
lessons: Confirm protocol approval, participant eligibility, informed consent, and the current study version.
Review AI-assisted screening results manually before contacting or enrolling a potential participant.
Track study arm, scheduled visits, source data, REDCap synchronisation, and protocol deviations.
Record adverse events promptly and report serious adverse events to the sponsor within 24 hours.
Protect blinding, restricted research data, and the complete participant audit trail.

knowledge.title: Knowledge base and policies
knowledge.summary: Find approved SOPs, policies, guidelines, and institutional reference material.
lessons: Search by topic, department, document type, owner, or keyword.
Check the version, approval status, effective date, and review date before following a document.
Ask the knowledge assistant focused questions and verify answers against the cited source.
Upload only authorised documents and assign accurate metadata, access, and review ownership.

settings.title: Facility and system administration
settings.summary: Configure the facility, users, roles, security, language, branding, and licensed modules.
lessons: Maintain facility identity, locations, departments, service points, branding, and document details.
Create named user accounts and grant the minimum role and module access needed for each job.
Review inactive users, password and session controls, permissions, and security events regularly.
Configure language, appearance, billing, integrations, and module availability without exposing secrets.
Test changes in a controlled workflow and record who approved significant configuration updates.
